models.name: Extreme Rainfall Nowcast (ConvLSTM / RainNet)
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting official IMD Kullu Doppler Weather Radar polar volume archives
models.limitations: Prototype tested on internal simulation; cannot verify convective cell tracking without radar grid.

models.name: Upper Beas Catchment Hydrological Runoff Model
models.data_gap_status: Validated on high-water survey footprint; continuous hourly hydrograph data pending
models.limitations: Small sample size (N=24: 12 inundated, 12 non-flooded); evaluates binary flood presence rather than continuous hydrograph volume.

models.name: Snowmelt Runoff Model (SRM / Degree-Day)
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting NCMRWF WRF 3km mountain boundary grids and high-altitude temperature telemetry
models.limitations: Degree-day algorithm unverified in glaciated Rohtang headwaters without in-situ weather stations.

models.name: Satellite Multi-Modal U-Net Flood Inundation Model
models.data_gap_status: Validated against 2D Sentinel-1 SAR water masks; high-density field GNSS marks pending
models.limitations: Evaluated against thresholded SAR water masks; radar subject to mountain shadow and terrain layover; NOT direct field survey.

models.name: Reservoir & Dam Operations Model (Pandoh Dam)
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting BBMB Pandoh Dam spillway gate opening logs and reservoir level records
models.limitations: Spillway discharge rule-curve unbenchmarked against actual dam operator logbooks during flash floods.

models.name: Beas Basin Landslide Susceptibility Random Forest
models.data_gap_status: Validated on GSI/HPSDMA July 2023 GPS scar inventory; ridge and forest scars pending
models.limitations: Significant domain shift on extreme out-of-distribution event; road-cut clustering along NH-3 corridor.

models.name: Beas Basin Rainfall-Induced Landslide Trigger LightGBM
models.data_gap_status: Evaluated on July 2023 event points; multi-season piezometer telemetry pending
models.limitations: 22 points sampled from ONE SINGLE storm event (July 9-10, 2023); does not demonstrate multi-year generalization.

models.name: InSAR & GNSS Geotechnical Slope Displacement
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting continuous GSI sub-centimeter GNSS and processed Sentinel-1 PS-InSAR velocity series
models.limitations: Displacement kinematics unverified without real-time in-situ borehole tiltmeter arrays.

models.name: Multi-Sensor Telemetry Anomaly Isolation Forest
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting physical field telemetry anomaly records from mountain stations
models.limitations: Tested on software-injected stuck floats and step jumps; physical silt fouling and biofouling unobserved.

models.name: River Stage & Discharge Hydrodynamic Model
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting authenticated continuous hourly river stage records from CWC Thalout / Bhuntar
models.limitations: High NSE achieved on synthetic autoregressive benchmark; does not represent genuine mountain river turbulence or rating-curve hysteresis.

models.name: High-Resolution Flood Depth Delineation Model
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting acoustic Doppler current profiler (ADCP) cross-sectional transects
models.limitations: Evaluated against 2D SAR water extents and DEM elevation; cross-sectional bathymetric depth unmeasured.

models.name: Landslide-Dam Burst & Cascade Flooding Model
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting geotechnical bathymetric surveys of temporary landslide dams in Beas headwaters
models.limitations: Empirical model calibrated on global dam breach catalog; regional alpine outburst mechanics uncalibrated locally.

models.name: Multi-Dimensional Socio-Economic Vulnerability
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting ward-level Census of India demographic data and Kullu DDMP household surveys
models.limitations: Theoretical vulnerability index; lacks empirical correlation with post-disaster household relief distributions.

models.name: Critical Infrastructure Loss & Disruptability Engine
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting official HP PWD road asset loss and bridge structural inspection damage surveys
models.limitations: Evaluated against synthetic loss fixture; does not reflect complex civil engineering structural failure modes.

models.name: Emergency Evacuation Routing & Shelter Optimization
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting district emergency evacuation drills and live traffic/debris road cut telemetry
models.limitations: Graph optimization evaluated on static OSM road network with simulated roadblocks; pedestrian congestion dynamics unmodeled.

models.name: Unified Multi-Hazard Risk Aggregator
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting operational emergency operations center (EOC) multi-hazard response logs
models.limitations: Theoretical risk weighting validated on synthetic scenarios; operational disaster decision room verification unconducted.

models.name: Early Warning Decision Gating & False Alarm Suppression
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting official SDMA warning issuance audit logs during live monsoon seasons
models.limitations: Tested on simulated multi-sensor thresholds and false alarms; live operational emergency warning dispatch unverified.

models.name: Multi-Sensor Dynamic Calibration & Drift Compensation
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting 12-month in-situ continuous sensor drift logs from Himalayan mountain streams
models.limitations: Tested on laboratory bench drift profiles; seasonal freezing, sediment scour, and silt accumulation unobserved.

models.name: Flash Flood Wave Celerity & Time-to-Impact Forecaster
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting synchronized dual-gauge hydrograph arrival records during steep mountain surges
models.limitations: Benchmarked on synthetic kinematic wave travel times; physical boulder damming and turbulent deceleration unmeasured.

models.name: Post-Disaster Structural Damage Assessment Classifier
models.data_gap_status: Awaiting official certified municipal structural engineer post-disaster damage tags
models.limitations: 510 inspection points are synthesized benchmark fixtures; NOT municipal post-disaster structural engineer sign-offs.
